met_analysis:
The upper air cyclonic circulation over southeast & adjoining eastcentral Bay of Bengal and Andaman Islands persisted over the same region at 1730 hours IST of today, the 22nd October. It is very likely to move west-northwestwards and under its influence a low-pressure area is likely to form over Southeast and adjoining Eastcentral Bay of Bengal around 23rd October, 2026. Then it is likely to move west-northwestwards and intensify further.
The Low Pressure area over Southwest Arabian Sea off Somalia coast persisted over the same region at 1730 hrs IST of today, the 22nd October, 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 5.8 km above mean sea level. It is very likely to move westwards as a low pressure area towards Somalia coast today, the 22nd October, 2026.
The Low Pressure areaover Comorin Area & adjoining areas of South Tamil Nadu and Keralam persisted over the same region at 1730 hrs IST of today, the 22nd October, 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 5.8 km above mean sea level. Theupper air cyclonic circulation over North Bangladesh persists and now lies at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Northeast Jharkhand & neighbourhood at 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over Haryana & adjoining northwest Uttar Pradesh at 3.1 km above mean sea level.
A fresh Western disturbance is likely to affect Northwest India from 24th October, 2026.
